items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I know you, and didn't you have Snyder playing bass drum with you?

ctx.x: Let me see if I can see. I lost my good specs, mind you. Saturday evening. Oh, my. My good one, Saturday evening.
Yeah. I know you, and didn't you have Snyder playing bass drum with you?
Oh, yeah. That's Snyder. He's Jack.
